🎬 The Weather Man (2005)

The Weather Man follows David Spritz, a successful television weather forecaster in Chicago whose professional popularity contrasts sharply with the struggles of his personal life. Although David enjoys a comfortable salary and recognition from viewers, he feels increasingly dissatisfied with his career, failed marriage, and strained relationships with his children. His attempts to reconnect with his ex-wife, Noreen, often lead to awkward encounters and painful misunderstandings, while his efforts to become a better father are complicated by his own insecurities and poor decisions. Meanwhile, David struggles to earn the respect of his accomplished father, Robert, a celebrated writer whose expectations have always weighed heavily on him. When an opportunity to join a prestigious national morning television program arises, David begins questioning whether greater professional success will finally bring him the happiness he has been searching for. From embarrassing public encounters and uncomfortable family conversations to unexpected moments of humor, emotional revelations, and difficult personal choices, he gradually confronts the reality that life cannot always be controlled or predicted. As David learns to accept responsibility for his mistakes and appreciate the relationships that matter most, he begins discovering a different understanding of success. Combining dark comedy, heartfelt drama, and thoughtful storytelling, the film explores family, regret, ambition, responsibility, and the unpredictable nature of life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 42m • R

🎥 Director: Gore Verbinski
